description: Sebenza's inbox nervous system. SessionStart puts pending operator answers and comments in front of the agent before any other work; Stop and SubagentStop refuse to end a turn while a blocked item has no inbox request, so the operator always learns that input is needed. All three fail open: no inbox, no daemon, no python3 or any error means silence, and the Stop block is capped at two per session.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/inbox.py" hook session-start
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/inbox.py" hook stop
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/inbox.py" hook subagent-stop
